acquisition method: Peptides were analyzed using a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA) operating in a data dependent acquisition (DDA) mode.
alkylation reagent: Free thiols were alkylated by 15 mM 2-iodoacetamide (IAM)
alkylation concentration: Free thiols were alkylated by 15 mM 2-iodoacetamide (IAM)
cleavage agent: Tryptic in-solution digestion was performed by adding sequencing grade trypsin (Worthington, 1:25 enzyme:protein ratio) to each sample
collision energy: an NCE of 32 and an dynamic exclusion time of 40 s.
fractionation method: All samples were combined and 45 µg of the mixture were fractionated by high pH reversed phase chromatography
instrument: Peptides were analyzed using a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA) operating in a data dependent acquisition (DDA) mode.
labeling: Samples including the synthetic peptides were labeled using TMT-10-plex (Thermo Scientific) at room temperature overnight with 550 rpm agitation.
reduction reagent: Protein reduction was performed using 5 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) (AppliChem, Darmstadt, Germany, 15 min at 37 °C, 750 rpm agitation).
reduction concentration: Protein reduction was performed using 5 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) (AppliChem, Darmstadt, Germany, 15 min at 37 °C, 750 rpm agitation).
